trends.name: Iran Escalation & Energy Crisis
trends.summary: Trump's threats to hit Iran 'extremely hard' are triggering oil price spikes (US crude now above Brent for first time since 2022), Hormuz Strait monitoring protocols between Iran-Oman, and Iranian threats against US tech companies. Energy costs cascading through supply chains with Amazon implementing 3.5% fuel surcharge on sellers and mortgage rates rising amid Iran war concerns.

trends.name: ECB Rate Hikes Signaling
trends.summary: ECB's Villeroy signals next key interest rate change is 'highly likely' to be upwards, though timing remains uncertain. ECB is closer to 'adverse intermediate scenario' than baseline, indicating hawkish pivot as inflation expectations rise. This represents major shift in European monetary policy and has knock-on effects for USD strength and global capital flows.

trends.name: AI Chip Demand Drivers
trends.summary: Broadcom's AI story remains in early innings with strong demand fundamentals. Iranian Revolutionary Guard threatens attacks on US tech companies including NVDA and AAPL, creating geopolitical risk premium for AI semiconductor leaders. Adeia positioning as hidden enabler of HBM chip architecture.

trends.name: Tech IPO Activity Heating Up
trends.summary: SpaceX IPO could be largest-ever public offering, with Walter Isaacson discussing implications for Elon Musk's portfolio. OpenAI acquiring tech podcast TBPN signals consolidation in AI content/distribution. Strong appetite for mega-cap tech IPOs signals risk-on sentiment despite macro headwinds.

trends.name: Mortgage Rates & Housing Pressure
trends.summary: 30-year mortgage rates rising to 6.46% (up from 6.38% week prior) with fifth consecutive week of increases tied to Iran war inflation concerns. Trump downplays major reform bills, focusing on interest rates as housing constraint. Higher rates directly pressuring affordability and residential real estate demand.

trends.name: Tesla Delivery Miss & EV Headwinds
trends.summary: Tesla stock drops over 5% on disappointing deliveries report, signaling continued EV market softness. Delivery weakness amid higher financing costs and consumer macro concerns suggests demand deceleration in critical category.

trends.name: US Economic Slowdown Intensifying
trends.summary: Multiple signals of deteriorating macro outlook: weak job creation (Revelio Labs nonfarm employment +19.4k in March), economists now predicting 'a lot worse' outlook than two weeks ago, and S&P 500 correction floor potentially at 6,000. US economy showing soft landing skepticism with structural employment weakness.

trends.name: Pharmaceutical Sector Catalysts
trends.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals showing strong momentum with label expansions for ALYFTREK and TRIKAFTA plus robust demand. Viridian Therapeutics with positive Phase III data on elegrobart for thyroid eye disease. Immunovant advancing brepocitinib program. Biotech sector benefiting from positive clinical readouts and demand strength.

trends.name: Retail & Membership Fee Inflation
trends.summary: Sam's Club hiking membership fees with analysts predicting Costco and BJ's could follow suit. Fee increases passing through to consumers amid elevated operational costs from energy inflation and geopolitical tensions. Consumer inflation pressures broadening beyond traditional categories.

trends.name: Political Risk & Regulatory Upheaval
trends.summary: Trump fires Attorney General Pam Bondi signaling potential policy shifts. Federal commission suing 3 states over prediction market regulation, creating regulatory uncertainty. Political transitions and enforcement actions creating headline volatility and corporate compliance uncertainty.

trends.name: Fixed Income Volatility & Yield Compression
trends.summary: Bond ETFs like SRLN offering 7.7% yields facing pressure as rate cut expectations diminish due to ECB hawkishness and inflation persistence. BNDI positioning as volatility hedge. Fixed income allocation case weakening as rising rate environment discourages new buying.

trends.name: Regional Sports Networks Distress
trends.summary: Regional sports networks faltering despite soaring ratings, indicating structural media business model breakdown. Cord-cutting and advertising fragmentation creating margin compression for content providers. Signals broader media valuation concerns.
